_comment: Rules are enabled by default; only deliberate exceptions appear here.

MD013._comment: Line length: prose is wrapped at 80, but tables and code blocks are not.

MD024._comment: Repeated headings are fine when nested under different parents -- the troubleshooting guide has a 'Cause' under every symptom.

MD033._comment: Inline HTML is used for <details> blocks in the reports and docs.

MD041._comment: The first line of a file need not be a heading: several start with a comment banner.

MD046._comment: Fenced code blocks only; indented blocks are ambiguous next to lists.

MD029._comment: Ordered lists number sequentially, so a runbook step can be referenced by number.
